CITY of AZUSA PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES

  December 11, 2019
  7:00 p.m.

NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports for the Planning Commission projects will
be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the
Planning Division and during regular hours at the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any
agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5289. The Planning Commission
Meeting will be held at 7:00 p.m. in the Civic Auditorium located at 213 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa,
California.

A)  CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Avila called the meeting to order at 7:00 pm.

B)  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chair Avila led the pledge of allegiance.

C)  SWEARING IN

  Swearing in Commissioner Mercedes Castro

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, introduces Mercedes Castro and Jeffrey Cornejo,
  City Clerk.

  Jeffrey Lawrence Cornejo, Jr., City Clerk, swears Mercedes Castro on to the Planning
  Commission.

  Chair Avila steps down from his position as chair of the Planning Commission.

  Vice Chair Donnelson leads the Planning Commission Meeting

D)  ROLL CALL

  Members Present: CASTRO, DONNELSON, LEE,
  Members Absent: ALLEN, RAMIREZ
  Staff Present: Henry Castillo, BB&K Attorney, Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, Dean
  Flores, Assistant Planner and Elijio Sandoval, Planning Technician
   PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  December 11, 2019
  Page 2

E)  MINUTES

1.  October 9, 2019

  Commissioner Lee made motion to approve the October 9, 2019 Planning Commission
  Minutes. Vice Chair Donnelson seconded. The item was approved with the following
  vote:

  AYES: DONNELSON, LEE
  NOES: NONE
  ABSTAIN: CASTRO
  ABSENT: RAMIREZ, ALLEN

F)  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION - (Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without
  interruption up to five (5) minutes in compliance with applicable meeting rules.
  Questions to the speaker or response to questions or comments shall be handled after the
  speaker has completed his/her comments).

  None.

G)  PUBLIC MEETING

  None.

H)  STUDY SESSION

  1. Study Session for proposed Code Amendment No. 246 for a Code Cleanup of Chapter 88
  of the City’s Municipal (Development) Code

  The City is initiating the proposed Code Cleanup and is requesting that the Planning
  Commission conduct a Study Session and to continue the item for the January 8, 2020
  meeting for a decision on the item.

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, introduces Dean Flores, Assistant Planner.

  Dean Flores, Assistant Planner, presents the item.

  Vice Chair Donnelson asks about awning and gallery setbacks in other zones.

  Commissioner Lee asks about temporary canopies in driveways. Vice Chair Donnelson
  follows up with a question regarding visibility of canopies.

  Commissioner Castro asks about the exposed tubing section along all of Route 66.

  Manuel Munoz, Planning Manager, and Dean Flores, Assistant Planner both respond and
  elaborate on the questions.
   PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  December 11, 2019
  Page 3

  Vice Chair Donnelson moved the item to the next scheduled meeting.

I)  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

J)  NEW BUSINESS

  1. Brown Act Training

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, introduces Henry Castillo, BB&K Attorney.

  Henry Castillo, BB&K Attorney, presents the item.

  2. Planning Commission Chairperson and Vice Chairperson Nomination

  Vice Chair Donnelson moved the item to the next scheduled meeting, Commissioners
  Castro and Lee agreed.

  3. Approval of 2020 Planning Commission Schedule

  Commissioner Castro made motion. Vice Chair Donnelson seconded. The item was
  approved with the following vote:

  AYES: CASTRO, DONNELSON, LEE
  NOES: NONE
  ABSTAIN: NONE
  ABSENT: RAMIREZ, ALLEN

K)  REPORTS AND COMMUNICATION

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, reports on the cancellation of the next scheduled
  meeting, Wednesday, December 25, 2019, due to it being a holiday.

L)  DISCUSSION ITEMS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSIONERS

  Commissioner Lee congratulates Commissioner Castro on her appointment and
  welcomes her to the Planning Commission.

  Vice Chair Donnelson echoes the sentiment.

M)  ADJOURNMENT

  Vice Chair Donnelson adjourned the meeting at 8:28 pm
   PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  December 11, 2019
  Page 4

UPCOMING MEETING: January 8, 2020

  Except as specifically provided, public hearing items are appealable to the
  City Council in accordance with the provisions of the City Code.
  In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in
this meeting, please contact the Economic and Community Development Department - Planning Division,
  (626) 812-5289
  Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make arrangements to ensure
  accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35.102.104 ADA Title II).
